title: Same Judgement, Different Scores: Numerical Scoring Topology in LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
abstract: arXiv:2611.26077v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly used as automated evaluators to reduce the cost and time required for human annotation. However, the role of scoring-scheme design in the reliability of LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation remains underexplored. To address this problem, we introduce numerical scoring topology, which characterizes the structural design of a scoring scheme in terms of its scale width, granularity, offset, symmetry, and boundary placement. Building on this definition, we conduct the first systematic study of how numerical scoring topology influences zero-shot LLM-as-a-Judge evaluation across diverse benchmarks and judge models. Our results show that numerical scoring topology systematically affects judge scores, calibration, and robustness, particularly in judgment-intensive evaluations. translated_title: 相同的判断，不同的分数：LLM-as-a-Judge评估中的数值评分拓扑
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用作自动评估器，以降低人工标注所需的成本和时间。然而，评分方案设计在LLM-as-a-Judge评估可靠性中所起的作用仍未得到充分研究。为解决这一问题，我们提出了数值评分拓扑的概念，它从量程宽度、粒度、偏移、对称性和边界位置等方面刻画评分方案的结构设计。基于这一定义，我们首次系统地研究了数值评分拓扑如何在多种基准测试和评判模型下影响零样本LLM-as-a-Judge评估。结果表明，数值评分拓扑会系统性地影响评判分数、校准和鲁棒性，尤其是在判断密集型的评估任务中。在许多设置下，偏移的和狭窄的评分范围往往会引起最大的分数偏差。我们进一步发现，更强、更大的评判模型……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出“数值评分拓扑”概念，并首次系统研究证明LLM-as-a-Judge评估中评分方案的结构设计（量程宽度、粒度、偏移、对称性与边界位置）会系统性影响评判分数、校准与鲁棒性，其中偏移和狭窄的评分范围会导致最大的分数偏差。
